# beta). The fixture is testdata/tool-enumeration/stream-live.sse.

# Section 1 lists the names the v1 run stream records in tool_call events. These are the
# names the provider matches. Section 2 is the model-facing inventory the agent wrote to
# ./tools.txt when asked; the model names map onto the stream names (Shell -> run_terminal_cmd,
# Read -> read_file, Write/StrReplace -> edit_file, Glob -> file_search, Grep -> grep_search,
# Delete -> delete_file, TodoWrite -> todo_write, WebFetch -> web_fetch, WebSearch -> web_search,
# GenerateImage -> generate_image, AwaitShell -> await, WriteCanvas/ReadCanvas ->
# write_canvas/read_canvas, GetDynamicTools -> get_mcp_tools, CallDynamicTool -> mcp).
